systems.system: KfW E-Governance Project: digitalising civil registry services
systems.country_label: civil registry services (key services provided at the communal level)
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Economy and Digital Transformation (MENTD) leads; KfW finances, EUR 20 million, contract signature expected by January 2025
systems.tiers: communes of the southern region whose mayors' and prefects' offices are to be connected by fibre

note: No fact: the passage (World Bank PAD, 25 November 2024) says only that a KfW project in final preparation will digitalise civil registry services in southern communes, without saying whether that is registration, copies of acts or old registers, so the system is unclassified.
